news.title: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna wins National Book Award
news.summary_en: Brenda Hillman, who earned an MFA from the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop in 1976, is the winner of the 2026 National Book Award for Poetry.

news.title: Long-term utilities project on T. Anne Cleary Walkway to begin this fall
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa’s utility system operator, ENGIE, will begin a series of projects this fall to support an upcoming utility tunnel reconstruction project that is expected to last more than three years. A section of the Currier Tunnel, an underground utility tunnel that runs underneath T. Anne Cleary Walkway, needs to be replaced due to its age and condition.

news.title: Iowa-connected Voyager 1 reaches historic milestone in space
news.summary_en: The Voyager 1 spacecraft, with deep, longstanding ties to the University of Iowa, has reached a historic milestone: traveling so far into space that its signal now takes a full day to reach Earth, even traveling at the speed of light. Nearly 50 years after launch, Iowa scientists remain part of the mission, continuing to explore the mysteries of interstellar space.

news.title: UI aerospace research, flight-testing lab opens second location at Eastern Iowa Airport
news.summary_en: The UI’s Operator Performance Laboratory has opened a second location at the Eastern Iowa Airport in Cedar Rapids to expand its aerospace research and flight-testing capabilities while bringing university researchers, students, and industry partners closer together. The new space also will create experiential learning opportunities for undergraduate and graduate students.

news.title: Big ideas in research, creative discovery taking shape at Iowa
news.summary_en: The UI is building momentum and helping researchers, artists, and students bring new ideas to life through efforts guided by its 2022–2027 Strategic Plan. From supporting NASA space studies to expanding opportunities for cancer research and the arts, Iowa is investing in the people and facilities needed to advance scientific discoveries and creative work.

news.title: 3MT winner sheds light on turning food waste into renewable energy
news.summary_en: Zoe Kramin is researching how light-based technology and artificial intelligence could help wastewater treatment plants turn more food waste into renewable energy.

news.title: Iowa's first women's wrestling recruit makes history on the world stage
news.summary_en: As the first recruit of the Iowa women’s wrestling team, Kylie Welker has helped build the program into a national powerhouse while becoming the first American wrestler to win three consecutive U23 world titles. With the first home meet of her final season approaching, lessons from Iowa's coaches and classrooms are preparing her to pursue Olympic gold and a future in coaching.

news.title: Photo gallery: Dance Gala 2026 brings stories to life
news.summary_en: Hancher Auditorium came alive Nov. 13–14 as University of Iowa students took center stage for the Department of Dance’s 45th annual Dance Gala.
